allow: Bash(git commit -m 'feat: derive layer, preview material, assign/sample, presets, auto-assign/compact *)

PowerShell($cmd = Get-Command blender -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($cmd\) { $cmd.Source } else { Get-ChildItem "C:\\Program Files\\Blender Foundation" -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Join-Path $_.FullName "blender.exe" } | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ } })

PowerShell($paths = @\("C:\\Program Files\\Blender Foundation","C:\\Program Files\\Blender"\) ; foreach \($p in $paths\) { if \(Test-Path $p\) { Get-ChildItem -Path $p -Recurse -Filter blender.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName } })
